title: Cobblemon Islands
description: Cobblemon Server with EVERY Pokemon Model, Megas, Z-Moves, Terastalization, Gyms, Quests, Raids, Expeditions, Dens and more!
body:
# 🏝️ Welcome to Cobblemon Islands! | 🔗 **Quick Links** | 🏝️ **Destination** | | :---: | :---: | | **Official Discord** | [**Join the Community**](https://discord.gg/cobblemonislands) | | **Wiki & Guides** | [**Read the Knowledge Base**](https://wiki.cobblemonislands.com) | | **Latest Versions** | [**Download on Modrinth**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/cobblemon-island/versions) | | **Official Website** | [**Visit CobblemonIslands.com**](https://www.cobblemonislands.com) |
--- ## ✨ Modpack Features & Highlights Experience a redefined Pokémon adventure in Minecraft. Cobblemon Islands combines the best of the Cobblemon mod with exclusive server-side features and custom content. * **🌌 Five Unique Realms:** Adventure through the Sun, Moon, and Star realms, along with custom Nether and End regions, each featuring shared progress and unique secrets. * **📈 Professional Progression:** Challenge a full set of **Player-Run Gyms**, climb the competitive ladder in **Ranked Battles**, or complete your Pokédex for exclusive rewards. * **🎭 Exclusive Custom Models:** Access the most extensive library of custom skins and remodels including **Gladiator Chatot**, **Space Haunter**, and **Mailman Dragonite**. * **🏹 Dynamic World Events:** Participate in **Mass Outbreaks**, seasonal themed activities, and legendary raids with a system designed to reward active players. * **🏠 Community & Economy:** Engage in a player-led economy with chest shops, global trade, and protected land claiming for your builds. * **🛠️ Optimized Experience:** Built on Fabric for peak performance, featuring integrated wikis, custom GUIs, and QoL mods to keep the focus on the journey. ---
